notes.title: 《对弈五千年》正式版上线！
notes.content:
一、【上线公告】：
【进游戏先进（选项）调出牌速度吧宝子！】
很高兴告诉大家！
国风易经游戏——《对弈五千年》已经于7月15日上线！
本游戏是单机买断制卡牌游戏，无内购和广告，
游戏的灵感来源于《易经》和肉鸽卡牌游戏的结合，
玩家将运用易经卦象的各种技能搭配，帮助历史上的中国人民突破天幕的重重考验，经历各种历史事件。

既然《易经》是五千年来根植于中华文明的源代码，
今天请您用卡牌游戏这种全新的形式，
以《易经》哲学观为钥匙，
尝试【推演】出古人眼中的“易经历史观”！

【注意】
1、由于Demo版本时间较早，为免与正式版存档引起数据混乱，因此DEMO版即日起停用。
2、开发的时间和精力有限，肉鸽卡牌游戏的排列组合实在太多，难免会有bug，我们向被影响游戏体验的朋友真诚致歉，请通过各种渠道向我们反馈，我们会不断进行修正与体验优化！
3、进度读档功能由于一些偶发性bug难以定位，为保证玩家的良好体验，本版本暂时停用进度读档，未来一两周内测试无误即可推出使用；
4、近期更新功能预告：玩家在太虚商店时也可查看自己的牌库。

notes.title: The trial version of "A Hand Across Five Thousand Years"
notes.content:
Through the joint efforts of our team members, the first trial version of "Five Thousand Years of Playing" has finally been released to everyone at the New Product Festival!

This trial version includes:
1 historical event level;
36 hexagram cards
20 star cards
12 zodiac (Earthly Branch) cards
3 types of hand enhancement
10 random bosses
(It is estimated that the size of the trial deck is about one fourth of the official version)

Specially added content:
Divination system:
Users can obtain new hexagram cards through divination;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170962/57536c9981aaf86aaf48cc0e500fae3e15503393.png[/img]

And upgrade and downgrade the hexagram cards.
After upgrading, remember to use the divination values you have obtained in the "Favorites" section!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170962/04b6e7237367d2289fe305efe964d6cc7ceab647.png[/img]

Apology Statement:
Due to the rushed production of this trial version, there are still many bugs that need to be found or fixed. We sincerely apologize to our players and friends in advance!
You can get a better gaming experience in our subsequent patched versions in a few days, or you can try it out first and give us feedback on bugs or suggestions!
We will include players who provide feedback in the activity prize pool, and in future events, we will draw official CDKEYs or peripheral gifts from the prize pool to give to lucky players!
Please use WeChat to scan the QR code below for the quick feedback of bugs:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170962/03622a2b3d2691d5c999655c7ef0ec7f79cbecf6.jpg[/img]

Thank you very much to the players for experiencing our game!
I look forward to working together to make her better!
